size_pct_nav_at_cost: Full exit; initial about 11% PSH NAV. Added 39% more shares in March before May exit.

drivers.driver: Pershing's smaller scale permits more nimble allocation than Berkshire.
drivers.quote: The one advantage we have over Berkshire is just relative scale

drivers.driver: Berkshire faces a difficult task deploying its enormous cash pool.
drivers.quote: Berkshire has the problem, if you will, of deploying $130 billion of capital.

drivers.driver: Use flexibility while preserving liquidity for more attractive direct opportunities.
drivers.quote: our view was we should take advantage of that nimbleness, preserve some extra liquidity in the event that prices get more attractive again

entry_valuation_stated: Original August 2019 letter: 14x next-12-month manager-estimated economic EPS, under 12x net excess cash, assuming 7% normalized insurance-investment returns. This is stronger sourced evidence than an unsourced 1.2x entry book shorthand.
outcome_note: Full exit May 2020. PSH 2020 gross NAV contribution -3.1 percentage points; not a lifetime dollar P&L. Exact realized loss not independently recovered.
pack_quality_notes: Ten documents. Original August 2019 thesis recovered directly, with short exact extracts. May 27 disclosure excluded.
